energyPlan.method: NIH/NIDDK Body Weight Planner source equations, calculated locally; automatic body-fat/RMR estimates and default carbohydrate/sodium assumptions. No change in activity.

Reaching 79 kg by December 10 implies about 1 kg/week, an ambitious pace; these are planning estimates, not a guarantee. We’ll adjust using your food, exercise and weight trend.

macroPlan.note: Starting targets: protein about 1.6 g/kg current weight (rounded to 140 g); carbs and fat split the remaining calories within adult macronutrient distribution ranges. 140*4 + 193*4 + 42*9 = 1710 kcal by standard 4/4/9 planning factors. Fiber 38 g is the adequate-intake guideline for men aged 19–50; it is included within carbohydrate intake, not an additional calorie allowance. Targets are flexible guides and will be reviewed if calories, weight, activity or tolerance changes.

meals.title: Panda Express plate
meals.description: Half fried rice, half Super Greens, one Black Pepper Sirloin Steak entree, one Orange Chicken entree, and one fortune cookie.
meals.assumptions: Assumes the entire plate was eaten, standard entree portions, and half of each listed side portion. User confirms eating the fortune cookie (20 kcal, 5 g carbs per published standard cookie). Receipt order time is not necessarily eating time. Portion variation is represented by approximate ranges. Official Panda Express values checked October 6, 2026: fried rice 610 kcal/full side, Super Greens 180 kcal/full side, steak 200 kcal/entree, Orange Chicken 560 kcal/entree.
meals.analysis: The half-greens choice adds vegetables and fiber. Orange Chicken is the largest calorie contribution (560 kcal), followed by the half portion of fried rice (305 kcal).

suggestions.title: Try teriyaki chicken for one entree
suggestions.detail: Replacing the Orange Chicken with a standard serving of grilled teriyaki chicken would reduce the published meal total by about 280 kcal while adding about 19 g protein. Keep the half-greens side if you enjoy it.

meals.title: Orgain Vanilla Bean protein · 2 scoops
meals.description: Two scoops of Orgain Organic Protein + 50 Superfoods, Vanilla Bean, mixed with water. No caloric additions.
meals.assumptions: User confirms water only. Two scoops are one 51 g serving according to the manufacturer’s product guide, not two servings. Calories (160) and protein (21 g) match the photographed front label. Carbs, fat and fiber use an older manufacturer Vanilla Bean 160-kcal panel as provisional estimates; the back label may differ.
meals.analysis: Provides 21 g protein for 160 kcal. Mixing with water adds no calories.

meals.title: Marinated beef with white rice
meals.description: Marinated beef: two hand-sized portions, with 1 cup cooked white rice, as reported by the user.
meals.assumptions: User confirms 1 cup cooked rice and two hand-sized portions of beef. Beef is provisionally modeled as roughly 200 g cooked (about 170–230 g); hand size is not a measured weight. Rice contributes around 205 kcal; beef cut, fat content and marinade sugar/oil remain unknown. Includes all reported rice and beef portions. The 600–950 kcal range is a judgment-based portion/recipe estimate, not a measured confidence interval.
meals.analysis: Adds a substantial amount of protein. Beef fat and marinade/oil are the main sources of calorie uncertainty. White rice provides carbohydrate but relatively little fiber; no vegetable side is visible.

suggestions.title: Add a vegetable side and consider a leaner cut
suggestions.detail: Keep a satisfying portion of beef, and add broccoli, cabbage or another vegetable for fiber and volume. If choosing the ingredients, a leaner beef cut and measured cooking oil can lower calories without removing the protein source.
